paragraphs: Life360 is a leading technology platform connecting millions of people throughout the world to the people, pets and things they care about most. We have created a new category at the intersection of family, technology, and safety to help keep families connected and safe. Our core offering, the Life360 mobile application, includes features like communications, driving safety, digital safety and location sharing. Beyond the everyday, Life360 also provides much-needed protection and saves lives, which is crucial for families in emergency situations such as natural disasters, vehicle collisions, physical property theft, and digital identity theft. The Life360 mobile application operates under a "freemium" model where its core offering is available to members at no charge, with additional membership subscription options that are available but not required.

In addition to the Life360 mobile application, we also offer hardware tracking devices through the sale of Tile by Life360, Inc. devices ("Tile") and Life360 Pet GPS devices to keep members close to the people, pets and things they care about most.

Our suite of product and service offerings, including the Life360 and Tile mobile applications, and related third-party services, is system and platform-agnostic, allowing our products and services to work seamlessly for our members, regardless of the different devices they use. As of December 31, 2025, we had approximately 95.8 million Monthly Active Users ("MAU"), and 2.8 million global Paying Circles on the Life360 Platform, as described below, representing a year-over-year increase of 20% and 26%, respectively. We define a Paying Circle as a group of Life360 members with a paying subscription who have been billed as of the end of period.

Our revenue is generated from the sale of subscriptions, hardware tracking devices used to access our services, and from partnerships, including through the placement of ads within our platform, and the sale of aggregated, non-personally identifiable data for data insight purposes.
For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, we generated: •Total revenue of $489.5 million, $371.5 million, and $304.5 million, respectively;
◦Subscription revenue of $369.3 million, $277.8 million, and $220.8 million, respectively;
◦Hardware revenue of $51.8 million, $57.6 million, and $58.2 million, respectively; ◦Other revenue of $68.4 million, $36.0 million, and $25.5 million, respectively; and
•Net income of $150.8 million in 2025, and net loss of $4.6 million, and $28.2 million in 2024 and 2023, respectively.

We currently offer four key product features that make up the Life360 Platform: (i) location coordination and safety, (ii) driving safety, (iii) digital safety, and (iv) emergency assistance. Each of these features keeps members connected to the important people in their lives by organizing them into groups called "Circles". A member selects who to invite to their Circle and what information a Circle, or any individual member within that Circle, receives.

Location coordination and safety features include real-time location, location history, and smart notifications such as location-specific alerts, driving alerts, and crime reports. Driving safety features include crash detection, roadside assistance, family driving summaries, and individual driver reports. Digital safety features include data breach alerts, identity theft protection, stolen funds reimbursement, and credit monitoring. Emergency assistance features include SOS with emergency dispatch, disaster response, medical assistance, and travel support.

The Life360 mobile application operates under a "freemium" model where its core offering is available to members at no charge, with paid membership subscription options that are available but not required. Paid subscription options offer members a comprehensive suite of premium safety services. We expect that, from time to time, the prices of our membership plans in each country may change and that we may implement other plan and price variations.

Our hardware products, which include Tile branded bluetooth and Life360 Pet GPS devices, seamlessly integrate with the Life360 Platform. The Tile Bluetooth® network leverages the installed base of Life360 members to scan for locations of devices, while our Life360 Pet GPS devices leverage GPS and cellular networks, generating even higher confidence that we can locate lost devices and pets of our customers. Our hardware products are sold through online and brick and mortar retail channels as well as directly on our website and are available, in various shapes, sizes, and price points for different use cases. The Tile mobile application offers a free service as well as two paid subscription options: Premium and Premium Protect, which offer additional services such as warranties and item reimbursement. The Life360 Pet GPS requires a Gold or Platinum Life360 subscription and offers additional location tracking services.

To help families stay connected and safe, we have developed a scalable mobile-first technology platform that protects our members' data and ensures operational integrity, security, and performance. Highlights of our technology platform include a robust location engine design, scalable and modern technology infrastructure, and seamless third-party integration.

We have designed an end-to-end technology location solution that allows us to deliver real-time location-based experiences and includes functionality such as storage, processing, and communication of events, locations, drives, maps, places, networking, and visualization of device characteristics for people, pets, and things. The Tile finding network has been integrated into the Life360 Platform. This integration allows members and Paying Circles to keep track of their things and connect with each other through the Life360 Platform. Through our strategic partnership with Hubble Network Inc., ("Hubble"), and subject to successful development and integration, we may expand our location tracking capabilities.

headings: If we fail to monetize members through subscription plans, our business, financial condition, and results of operations may be harmed.
We have in the past, and may in the future, need to change our pricing models to compete successfully.
The market for our offerings is evolving, and our future success depends on the growth of this market and our ability to anticipate and satisfy consumer preferences in a timely manner.
Changes to our existing brands, products, and services, or the introduction of new brands, products, or services, could fail to attract or retain members or generate revenue and profits.
Unfavorable media coverage and publicity could damage our brands and reputation and materially adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
Inappropriate actions by third parties or our members could be attributed to us and cause damage to our brands.
Our business could be harmed if we are unable to accurately forecast demand for our products and services and to adequately manage our product inventory.
We depend on retailers and distributors to sell and market our hardware products, and our failure to maintain and further develop our sales channels could harm our business.

We rely on key data partners, and any termination of our agreements with such data partners could have a material adverse effect on our revenues, business, financial condition, and results of operations.
Our future success depends on the continuing efforts of our executive officers and other key employees and our ability to attract and retain highly skilled personnel and senior management.
Our member metrics and other estimates are subject to inherent challenges in measurement, and real or perceived inaccuracies in those metrics may negatively affect our reputation and our business.
The limited operating history of our new brands, products, and services makes it difficult to evaluate our current business and future prospects.
paragraphs: Our business is subject to a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks described below, as well as the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including our financial statements and the related notes and "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations." The occurrence of any of the events or developments described below could harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects. In such an event, the market price of our common stock could decline.

Our business is subject to numerous risks and uncertainties. These risks and uncertainties may cause our operations to vary materially from those contemplated by our forward-looking statements. These risk factors include:

•If we fail to retain existing members or add new members, or if our members decrease their level of engagement with our products and services or do not convert to paying subscribers, our revenue, business, financial condition, and results of operations may be significantly harmed.

•If we are not able to maintain the value and reputation of our brands, or if we are not able to compete successfully with current or future competitors, our ability to expand our member base and maintain our relationships with partners and other key service providers may be impaired and our business, financial condition, and results of operations may be harmed.
•Changes to our existing brands, products, and services, or the introduction of new brands, products, or services, could fail to attract or retain members or generate revenue and profits.

•Our growth and profitability rely, in part, on our ability to attract members through cost-effective marketing efforts. Any failure in these efforts could materially adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.

Life360 is a leading technology platform used to locate the people, pets, and things that matter most to families. Life360 is creating a new category at the intersection of family, technology, and safety to help keep families connected and safe. Our core offering, the Life360 mobile application, includes features that range from communications to driving safety and location sharing. The Life360 mobile application operates under a "freemium" model where its core offering is available to members at no charge, with three membership subscription options that are available but not required. We also generate revenue through hardware subscription services and the sale of hardware tracking devices. By offering devices and integrated software to members, we have expanded our addressable market to provide members of all ages with a vertically integrated, cross-platform solution of scale. We also generate other revenue from partnerships, including through the placement of ads within our platform, and the sale of aggregated, non-personally identifiable data for data insight purposes.
For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, we generated:
•Total revenues of $489.5 million and $371.5 million, respectively, representing year-over-year growth of 32%;
•Subscription revenues of $369.3 million and $277.8 million, respectively, representing year-over-year growth of 33%;
•Hardware revenues of $51.8 million and $57.6 million, respectively, representing year-over-year decline of 10%;
•Other revenues of $68.4 million and $36.0 million, respectively, representing year-over-year growth of 90%;
•Gross profit of $380.8 million and $279.2 million, respectively, representing year-over-year growth of 36%;
•Net income of $150.8 million and net loss of $4.6 million, respectively; and
•Operating cash flows of $88.6 million and $32.6 million, respectively.

As we focus on growing our customers and revenue, and achieving profitability while investing for the future and managing risk, expenses and capital, the following factors and others identified in the section of this Annual Report on Form 10-K titled "Item 1A. Risk Factors" have been important to our business and we expect them to impact our operations in future periods:

Ability to Retain Trusted Brand. We strongly believe in our vision to become the indispensable safety membership for families, with a suite of safety services that span every life stage of the family. Our business model and future success are dependent on the value and reputation of the Life360 and Tile by Life360, Inc. ("Tile") brands. Our brand is trusted by approximately 96 million members as of December 31, 2025, and because we know the value of trust is immeasurable, we will continue to work tirelessly to provide useful, reliable, trustworthy, and innovative products and services.

Attract, Retain, and Convert Members. Our business model is based on attracting new members to our platform, converting free members to subscribers, and retaining and expanding subscriptions over time. Our continued success depends in part on our ability to offer compelling new products and features to our members, and to continue providing a quality user experience to convert and retain paying subscribers. We will also seek to increase brand awareness and customer adoption of our platform through various programs and digital and broad-scale advertising.

paragraphs: Life360 是一個連接全球數千萬人與他們最關心的人、寵物及物品的領先科技平台。我們已創造出一個結閤家庭、科技與安全的新類別，以協助家庭保持聯繫與安全。我們的核心產品，Life360 手機應用程式，包含通訊、駕駛安全、數位安全及位置分享等功能。除了日常使用外，Life360 還提供必要的保護並拯救生命，這對家庭在自然災害、車禍、財物竊盜及數位身分盜竊等緊急情況下至關重要。Life360 手機應用程式採用 "freemium" 模式運作，其核心產品對成員免費提供，並提供額外的訂閱方案，但非強制性。
除了 Life360 手機應用程式，我們也透過銷售 Tile by Life360, Inc. 裝置（"Tile"）及 Life360 寵物 GPS 裝置，提供硬體追蹤裝置，以協助成員與他們最關心的人、寵物及物品保持聯繫。

我們的產品與服務組合，包括 Life360 和 Tile 手機應用程式，以及相關第三方服務，與系統及平台無關，使我們的產品與服務能順暢運作於成員的各種不同裝置上。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們約有 95.8 百萬月活用戶（"MAU"），以及 2.8 百萬全球付費羣組在 Life360 平台，如下所述，分別較去年同期成長 20% 和 26%。我們將付費羣組定義為在期末已計費的 Life360 成員組。
我們的收入來自訂閱銷售、用以存取我們服務的硬體追蹤裝置，以及來自合作夥伴的收入，包括在平台內放置廣告，以及銷售聚合、非個人可識別資料用以提供數據洞察。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，2024 年及 2023 年，我們產生：•總收入為 489.5 百萬美元、371.5 百萬美元及 304.5 百萬美元，分別；
◦訂閱收入為 369.3 百萬美元、277.8 百萬美元及 220.8 百萬美元，分別；
◦硬體收入為 51.8 百萬美元、57.6 百萬美元及 58.2 百萬美元，分別；◦其他收入為 68.4 百萬美元、36.0 百萬美元及 25.5 百萬美元，分別；以及
•2025 年淨收入為 150.8 百萬美元，2024 年及 2023 年淨虧損為 4.6 百萬美元及 28.2 百萬美元，分別。
本公司目前提供四項關鍵產品功能，組成 Life360 平台：(i) 位置協調與安全、(ii) 駕駛安全、(iii) 數位安全、以及 (iv) 緊急協助。這些功能透過將人分組為稱為 "Circles" 的羣組，讓成員與他們生命中重要的親友保持連線。
位置協調與安全功能包括即時位置、位置歷史紀錄，以及智慧通知，例如位置特定警報、駕駛警報與犯罪報告。駕駛安全功能包括碰撞偵測、路邊協助、家庭駕駛總結與個人駕駛報告。數位安全功能包括資料外洩警報、身分盜用保護、遭竊資金賠償與信用監測。緊急協助功能包括 SOS 緊急派遣、災害應對、醫療協助與旅行支援。
Life360 手機應用程式運作於 "freemium" 模式，其核心功能對成員免費提供，而付費會員訂閱選項則為可選而非必須。付費訂閱選項提供成員一整套高階安全服務。本公司預期，各國的會員計畫價格可能不時調整，並可能實施其他計畫與價格變體。

本公司硬體產品，包括 Tile 品牌的藍牙裝置與 Life360 寵物 GPS 裝置，可與 Life360 平台無縫整合。Tile 藍牙® 網路利用 Life360 成員的已安裝基礎來掃描裝置位置，而 Life360 寵物 GPS 裝置則利用 GPS 與行動網路，產生更高的信心，使本公司能定位遺失的裝置與寵物。本公司硬體產品透過線上與實體零售通路銷售，也直接在本公司網站上銷售，並以不同形狀、尺寸與價格點，提供不同用途的選擇。Tile 手機應用程式提供免費服務，以及兩種付費訂閱選項：Premium 與 Premium Protect，提供額外服務，例如保固與物品賠償。Life360 寵物 GPS 需要 Gold 或 Platinum Life360 訂閱，並提供額外的位置追蹤服務。
為協助家庭保持連線與安全，本公司已開發出一個可擴展的行動優先科技平台，保護成員資料並確保運營完整性、安全性與效能。本科技平台的亮點包括強固的位置引擎設計、可擴展且現代化的科技基礎設施，以及無縫的第三方整合。

本公司已設計出一個端到端的科技位置解決方案，使本公司能提供即時的基於位置的體驗，並包含儲存、處理與通訊事件、位置、駕駛、地圖、地點、網路與裝置特徵可視化等功能，用以追蹤人類、寵物與物品。Tile 尋找網路已整合至 Life360 平台。此整合使成員與付費羣組能透過 Life360 平台追蹤其物品並彼此連線。透過與 Hubble Network Inc.（"Hubble"）的戰略合作夥伴關係，並在成功開發與整合的條件下，本公司可能擴展其位置追蹤能力。

paragraphs: 以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，應與本年度10-K表報表所附之合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。除歷史財務資訊外，以下討論包含基於目前計畫、預期與信念之展望性陳述，這些陳述涉及風險與不確定性。我們實際結果可能與展望性陳述中所討論者有重大差異，原因可能包括但不限於「項目1A. 風險因素」及「展望性陳述」中所討論之因素。
以下為我們2025年12月31日財年與2024年12月31日財年財務狀況及營運成果之比較討論。2024年12月31日財年與2023年12月31日財年財務狀況及營運成果之比較討論，請參閱我們於2025年2月27日提交予SEC之10-K表中「管理層對財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析」部分。

Life360為一項用以定位對家庭而言最重要之人、寵物與物品之科技平台。Life360正在創造一個結閤家庭、科技與安全之新類別，以協助家庭保持聯繫與安全。我們的核心產品為Life360行動應用程式，包含從通訊至駕駛安全與位置分享等功能。Life360行動應用程式採用「免費增值」模式，其核心產品對會員免費提供，並提供三種訂閱方案，但非強制。我們亦透過硬體訂閱服務與硬體追蹤裝置銷售產生收入。透過為會員提供裝置與整合軟體，我們已擴大可接觸市場，為所有年齡層之會員提供垂直整合、跨平台之規模解決方案。我們亦透過合作夥伴產生其他收入，包括在平台內放置廣告，以及銷售聚合、非個人可識別資料以用於數據洞察。
截至2025年12月31日及2024年12月31日財年，我們產生：
•總營業收入為 489.5 百萬美元及 371.5 百萬美元，分別代表年增 32%;
•訂閱收入為 369.3 百萬美元及 277.8 百萬美元，分別代表年增 33%;
•硬體營收為 51.8 百萬美元及 57.6 百萬美元，分別代表年減 10%；
•其他收入為 68.4 百萬美元及 36.0 百萬美元，分別代表年增 90%;
•毛利率為 380.8 百萬美元及 279.2 百萬美元，分別代表年增 36%；
•淨收入為 150.8 百萬美元及淨虧損為 4.6 百萬美元，分別；
•營運現金流為 88.6 百萬美元及 32.6 百萬美元，分別。
隨著我們專注於拓展客戶與營收，並在投資未來及管理風險的同時實現獲利，以下因素及其他在本年度報告表 10-K 之「項目 1A. 風險因素」部分所列的因素，對我們的業務至關重要，我們預期這些因素將影響我們未來的營運：

維持受信賴的品牌。我們堅信我們的願景要成為家庭不可或缺的安全會員資格，提供涵蓋家庭各生命階段的安全服務。我們的商業模式與未來的成功取決於 Life360 及 Tile by Life360, Inc. ("Tile") 品牌的價值與聲譽。我們的品牌受到約 96 百萬名會員信賴，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，因為我們知道信任的價值無法衡量，我們將持續努力提供實用、可靠、值得信賴且創新產品與服務。
吸引、留住並轉化會員。我們的商業模式基於吸引新會員至我們的平台，將免費會員轉為訂閱者，並持續留住及擴大訂閱。我們的持續成功在部分程度上取決於我們能否為會員提供有吸引力的新產品與功能，並持續提供優質的用戶體驗以轉化及留住付費訂閱者。我們也會透過各種方案及數位與大規模廣告活動，增加品牌知名度與用戶對我們平台的採用率。

headings: 與本公司業務相關的風險
若我們無法透過訂閱方案實現會員 monetize，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成損害。
過往我們曾且未來可能仍需調整價格模式以成功競爭。
我們的產品市場正在演進，未來的成功取決於該市場的成長以及我們預測並及時滿足消費者偏好的能力。
現有品牌、產品及服務的變更，或新品牌、產品或服務的推出，可能無法吸引或留住會員，或產生收入與利潤。
不利的媒體報導與宣傳可能損害我們的品牌與聲譽，並對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
第三方或會員的不當行為可能被歸咎於我們，並對我們的品牌造成損害。
本公司業務若無法準確預測產品與服務之需求，並適當管理產品存貨，可能受到損害。
我們依賴零售商與經銷商銷售與行銷我們的硬體產品，若無法維持並進一步發展銷售通路，可能損害本公司業務。
我們依賴關鍵資料合作夥伴，若與這些資料合作夥伴之協議終止，可能對我們之營業收入、業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
本公司未來之成功取決於高階主管與其他關鍵員工持續努力，以及本公司吸引並留住高技能人才與高階管理層之能力。
會員指標及其他估計數值會受到測量本質上之挑戰，若這些指標存在實質或被認為不準確，可能對本公司聲譽及業務造成負面影響。
新品牌、產品與服務之有限營運歷史，使評估本公司目前業務與未來前景變得困難。
paragraphs: 本公司業務面臨高度風險。您應謹慎考量下列所描述的風險，以及本年度報告表10-K中其他資訊，包括財務報表及相關附註，以及「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」。上述任何事件或發展發生，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果與前景造成損害。在這種情況下，本公司普通股的市場價格可能下跌。
本公司業務面臨許多風險與不確定性。這些風險與不確定性可能導致實際營運與我們財務預測有重大差異。這些風險因素包括：
•若我們無法留住現有會員或增加新會員，或若會員降低對我們產品與服務的參與度，或未能轉為付費訂閱者，則本公司營收、業務、財務狀況與營運成果可能受到重大損害。
•若我們無法維持品牌價值與聲譽，或無法成功與現有或未來競爭對手競爭，則我們擴大會員基礎與維持與合作夥伴及其他關鍵服務提供者的關係的能力可能受損，進而對本公司業務、財務狀況與營運成果造成損害。
•對現有品牌、產品與服務的變更，或推出新品牌、產品或服務，可能無法吸引或留住會員，或無法產生收入與利潤。
•本公司成長與獲利能力部分取決於我們透過成本效益高的行銷活動吸引會員的能力。若這些行銷活動失敗，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況與營運成果造成重大不利影響。
